provenance: Larry's son's written report, sent to the archive on the evening of 2026-09-05, answering the archive's questions about what Larry said at the table while drawing that afternoon. His son listened and did not take notes, so this is his summary from memory in his own words, not Larry's words.
text: The circle M stood for "Market". He said a explosion went off here at the Market. Not sure if he was at that Market explosion or was just referencing saomething in history though.
researchNotes: Said at the circled M at the head of the wide band on VD-0003. The label stays M, as written; this is what he said it stands for. Whether he was present at the explosion, or was recalling something he heard of, was not settled and is the first thing to ask. Which market and which explosion are research questions kept in research/drawings/README.md, not put to him. Ledger #35.
